content.title: About
content.content: Pre‑lightened coffee consists of Arabica beans that have undergone a light roast, preserving bright fruit and floral notes along with a moderate acidity. It works well for both espresso and filter brewing, delivering a balanced cup with a gentle sweetness.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Light roasting retains a high level of chlorogenic acids, which contribute to the coffee’s vivid acidity and aroma.
Arabica beans contain about 60 % more aromatic compounds than Robusta.
Pre‑lightened coffee is popular in home espresso machines because it is less prone to bitterness from under‑extraction.
In some cultures the first cup of light‑roasted coffee is served as a ceremonial welcome.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Coffee provides polyphenols that help combat free radicals and reduce oxidative stress.

items.title: Supports cognitive function
items.content: Caffeine improves alertness, memory, and reaction time, especially when consumed in moderate amounts.

items.title: Boosts metabolism
items.content: Caffeine can increase energy expenditure, contributing to a higher basal metabolic rate.

items.title: Contains magnesium and potassium
items.content: These minerals are essential for muscle function, nerve signaling, and fluid balance.

items.title: May lower risk of certain diseases
items.content: Regular moderate coffee consumption is associated with a reduced risk of Parkinson’s disease and some cancers.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat with excessive intake.

items.title: Increased stomach acidity
items.content: Coffee can aggravate gastritis or reflux symptoms in susceptible people.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine may amplify the effects of certain stimulants and diminish the efficacy of some sedatives.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: For pre‑lightened coffee, use a medium grind for filter brewing and a finer grind for espresso. Brew 18‑20 g of coffee with 300 ml of water at 92‑96 °C, steeping for 2‑3 minutes. Add milk, cream, or spices to taste if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store coffee in an airtight container in a cool, dry, dark place. Keep it away from air, moisture, and light to preserve flavor and aroma. Once opened, use within 2‑3 weeks for optimal freshness.
